actual_scope: Independently check #4331's saved GL3 length-seven and length-eight RUP refutations with a separately written hint-free forward RUP checker, closing #4331's open question 1 (no independent length-eight acceptance).
scope_change_reason: #4331's LRAT conversion of length eight hit its output limit, so only drat-trim had accepted it; a checker that needs no hints removes that dependency.
bottleneck_link: The minimum-nine GL3 model bound needs both refutations checked independently of one tool.
stop_rule: Stop once both saved certificates are checked or one fails.
evidence: rupcheck.c: length 7 verified (11,728 additions, 27,449 deletions ignored); length 8 verified (281,714 additions in order ending at the empty clause, 306,172 deletions ignored, all 587,886 proof lines, 191 s, 57 MB), inputs matching #4331's CERTIFICATES.json pins. rupcheck.py replays length 7 in CI; a dropped core clause and a flipped literal are rejected; random 3-CNF fuzz never accepts a satisfiable formula and accepts every tree refutation.
